# Promoted to repo memory: boopada-planner

Cite these in .sofar/repo.md by qualified handle — `boopada-planner M<n>` —
which is how `sofar doctor` sees that a promoted fact reached repo memory.

- **M1** (2026-09-15T08:56:20.215Z) — Provider gotcha: `providers.fx.getRates(base)` omits `base` itself from `rates` (its rate would be 1). The set of currencies the providers know is `{rates.base} ∪ keys(rates.rates)` — ten of them: AED EUR GBP INR JOD JPY NZD SGD USD VND. Take it from `apps/web/lib/reference.ts` (`getReference()`), never straight from `rates.rates`, or USD — the default home currency — fails its own validation.
- **M2** (2026-09-15T08:58:29.061Z) — A green `bun run build` does NOT prove the app runs: Next 16 builds with Turbopack and route handlers are only executed on request. Smoke-test every session with `cd apps/web && PORT=3987 BOOPADA_DB_PATH=/tmp/x/b.sqlite bun run start` then curl the routes — that is how the node:sqlite externalisation bug (D4) surfaced, as a runtime 500 with a clean build.
- **M3** (2026-09-15T09:06:28.748Z) — `bun test` runs every apps/web test file in ONE process, so module caches are shared: set BOOPADA_DB_PATH per file in beforeAll (getDb caches per path), and a file that sets BOOPADA_NOW must call `resetProviders()` after setting it and again after deleting it in afterAll, or the frozen clock leaks into other files. Route handlers with dynamic segments are called in tests as `PATCH(request, { params: Promise.resolve({ id }) })` — see apps/web/test/bucket-api.test.ts.
